title: Copyedit and audit MLS WG drafts
description: Requested by Mark 2026-10-21. Drafts: pq-ciphersuites-06, targeted-messages-01, virtual-clients-01, partial-02, combiner-02 (local copies in ~/PROJECT/IETF/specs; editors' copies in ~/GIT/mls-<name> at fb18956, ae3ab52, 65e960d, 7fef7c1, 380f0e1). Per draft: independent copyedit agent + audit agent, then an adversarial verify agent checks every finding against the editors' copy and existing upstream issues/PRs. Surviving findings become wg beads under this epic, each citing section + editors'-copy line + suggested fix. Nothing is posted upstream without Mark's per-item OK. Out of scope: federation-03 (dead), RFC 9750 (errata only).
